ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a hemispherical surface S, whose boundary is a circular plane; the vector n is perpendicular to this circular boundary plane, and the angle between the magnetic induction intensity vector B and n is α. Reasoning: According to the specified method, use the boundary disk to close the hemispherical surface S. The radius of this disk is r, and the area is πr^2. The normal of the disk is taken as n given in the problem, therefore the magnetic flux of the uniform magnetic field B through the disk is Φ_disk = B·πr^2·cosα. The magnetic field satisfies Gauss's law for magnetism, and the total magnetic flux through any closed surface is 0, so on the closed surface there is Φ_S + Φ_disk = 0. Therefore the magnetic flux of the hemispherical curved surface S is Φ_S = -Φ_disk = -πr^2Bcosα.

The unit vector \( \vec{n} \) normal to the plane of the boundary of \( S \) makes an angle \( \alpha \) with \( \vec{B} \). method.method_draft: Close the hemispherical surface by adding the circular disk of radius \(r\) in its boundary plane. Compute the flux through the disk using the angle between \(\vec B\) and the disk normal \(\vec n\): \(\Phi_{\text{disk}}=B(\pi r^2)\cos\alpha\). Since magnetic flux through any closed surface is zero, set \(\Phi_S+\Phi_{\text{disk}}=0\), giving \(\Phi_S=-\pi r^2B\cos\alpha\).

推理：按照指定方法，用边界圆盘把半球面 S 封闭起来。该圆盘半径为 r，面积为 πr^2。圆盘法向取为题中给出的 n，因此均匀磁场 B 穿过圆盘的磁通为 Φ_disk = B·πr^2·cosα。磁场满足高斯磁定律，任意闭合曲面的总磁通为 0，所以闭合曲面上有 Φ_S + Φ_disk = 0。因此半球曲面 S 的磁通为 Φ_S = -Φ_disk = -πr^2Bcosα。

method.method_draft: Replace the curved hemisphere by its net oriented area vector. The cap’s vector area is equal to the projected circular area with direction opposite to \(\vec n\): \(\vec A_S=-\pi r^2\vec n\). Dot this vector area with the uniform field: \(\Phi_S=\vec B\cdot\vec A_S=-\pi r^2\vec B\cdot\vec n=-\pi r^2B\cos\alpha\).
